 "title": "Update transform and test all demos",
 "command": "cat > programs/task-711f4eaa.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in colors}
    outer_color = max(colors, key=counts.get)
    inner_color = min(colors, key=counts.get)
    occupied = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in occupied), max(r for r,c in occupied)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in occupied), max(c for r,c in occupied)
    # Expand the minority-color region's bounding rectangle to the nearest
    # larger frame thickness: margin determined by the surrounding frame.
    inner = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == inner_color]
    ir0, ir1 = min(r for r,c in inner), max(r for r,c in inner)
    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r,c in inner), max(c for r,c in inner)
    # The contrast color fills the border-width halo outside the whole object.
    # Use the inset thickness when the inner pattern forms a filled rectangle,
    # otherwise the inset thickness on all four sides likewise sets halo size.
    pad = min(ir0-r0, r1-ir1, ic0-c0, c1-ic1)
    if pad < 1: pad = 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0,r0-pad), min(h,r1+pad+1)):
        for c in range(max(0,c0-pad), min(w,c1+pad+1)):
            if grid[r][c] == 0: out[r][c] = inner_color
    return out
PY
